name: CA$H Rally
notes: Portrait 720x1280 (Cocos2d-x Lua, IGT casino). Lobby = Regular Room (High Limit Room locked by level). Games are a 3-wide grid of ~195px square tiles with occasional full-width featured banners; each tile has a level-unlock badge bottom-left (5/30/60/70...). Lobby scrolls VERTICALLY. Right-side 'Feature Center' flyout overlaps the right column -> collapse it (tap its > arrow) before cataloging. New account forces: welcome gift -> tutorial first-game -> must level to Lv.2 (spin in the featured slot) to free the lobby -> level-up chest/wheel/milestone -> MISSIONS UNLOCKED -> LOGIN BONUS -> several $ paid offers (EARLY ACCESS, PICK ONE PUMPKIN PIE, THANKSGIVING) -> close all via their X, never tap a $ price button. Google Play Games 'create profile' dialog on launch -> 取消/Cancel. Home icon top-left (75,33) exits a slot to the lobby. RECORDING (2026-11-26): 'wolf_run_eclipse' is always playable and is entered through enter_via (Events & Offers -> HOT -> Level Road to Glory -> GO SPIN); a 2-minute test recording analysed cleanly. Grid games unlock progressively with the account level (each tile's badge = its unlock level; a 'NEW SLOTS UNLOCKED' popup at Lv.10 opened Stinkin Rich, High Roller, Fortune Coin Respin and others) - record those on an account that has them unlocked. XP comes from spinning: long-press SPIN = auto-spin. Known limit: a paid-offer popup the recorder cannot close forces an app restart; the page is saved as frames/<video>_snaps/danger_*.png - add its close button to x_templates.
